gen-righteous-gf-winky-sans: Winky Sans keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase, a modern, level-headed sans-serif. Winky Sans against Righteous gives the strongest tension here: tubing-like bowls that fill the line over a quiet, low-key text.
gen-righteous-gf-yantramanav: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowl-filled letters, even its g drawn in one unchanging line. Yantramanav sits beneath with tall lowercase huddled close and open terminal gaps, so give it a little extra size.
gen-righteous-outfit: Righteous fills the line with rod-bent bowls, loud and playful, while Outfit's cable-like sans curves stop short of closing, lower and friendlier.
gen-righteous-plus-jakarta-sans: Righteous hammers out commanding, bowl-heavy letters that look like thin steel rod bent into shape. But Plus Jakarta Sans stays monoline, its curve endings kept well apart, and sits lower in height.
gen-righteous-space-grotesk: Loud tubing letters meet a geometric ribbon, with Righteous filling every line with big bowls up top. Righteous is best at shouting; Space Grotesk is best at staying quiet.
gen-silkscreen-clash-grotesk: Approachable and clean, Clash Grotesk draws every line with no thick-and-thin modulation at all. Beside Silkscreen's lo-fi, spaghetti-thin letters with space you can almost feel, that shared flatness is what ties them.
gen-silkscreen-fs-hind: Hind reads neutral and professional, its lowercase nearly matching the capitals and the c ends never turning inward. Silkscreen does retro, spaced-out display best; Hind does steady text.
gen-silkscreen-fs-nunito: Pixel-spaced retro up top, soft and round below. Nunito follows with big round lowercase bowls and terminals finishing clear of the stem, so Silkscreen's lo-fi lines get a friendly counterweight.
gen-silkscreen-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Silkscreen leaves space around every letter you can almost feel, its line like spaghetti laid out in type. Pilcrow Rounded packs its letters tight with big counters and a tall lowercase, warm where the heading is lo-fi.
gen-silkscreen-gf-akatab: Akatab reads approachable, its round letters looking cupped rather than clenched, with low modulation. Silkscreen has zero modulation in its spaghetti line, and that flat-versus-soft difference is the pair's best trait.
